title: Spirits Bottle Daily Event Volume
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spirit:bottle
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(spirit_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many spirits bottle events land each day and how many distinct spirit type values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest spirits bottle records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct spirit type values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how much spirits bottle activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
